records.title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
records.reason: The paper distills a simulated air-hockey world-model policy into a 64-state diagonal linear recurrence, finding similar control performance to GRU with 88% fewer recurrent-core parameters and lower computation across five seeds. The authors limit conclusions to one simulated task, teacher, state size, and blackout horizon. This is robotics control, not LLM inference; only a weak recurrence-efficiency analogy remains.

records.title: DuSpaR: Dual-State Sparsifying Recurrent Unit with Feedback Modulation for Compute-Efficient Speech Processing
records.reason: DuSpaR uses a dual-state recurrent unit and ReLU-induced activation sparsity to skip matrix-vector operations for edge speech processing. The primary text evaluates speech recognition/processing efficiency, but the model/task is specialized audio processing and the evidence does not establish direct generative LLM/VLM serving gains; retain only as a weak SSM/efficient-recurrence connection.

records.title: Rethinking Multi-Image Re-Representation in Multi-Image Understanding
records.reason: Multi-image reasoning harness/re-representation; no direct compute, memory, latency, or serving optimization.

records.title: AVERT-VLN: Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
records.reason: Vision-language navigation error recovery and abstention training; robotics task behavior, no model inference-resource improvement.

records.title: When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic
records.reason: The paper studies when masking/pruning in compressed CLIP helps worst-group robustness and proposes a pre-deployment diagnostic, not a new LLM inference accelerator. It reports unstable robustness effects across datasets and measures the diagnostic’s own cost (about 27.5 ms/image after implementation correction); spatially coherent, separable backgrounds are the stated reliability boundary. Keep as adjacent token-pruning/robustness evidence, not a direct serving improvement.
